text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Setup PowerShell
      uses: PowerShell/PowerShell@v1
      
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0.x'
        
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        
    - name: Cache NuGet Packages
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: ~/.nuget/packages
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-
          
    - name: Install Dependencies
      run: |
        dotnet restore
        npm install -g @docusaurus/cli
        
    - name: Setup PSWriteOffice
      run: |
        git clone https://github.com/EvotecIT/PSWriteOffice.git C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice
        Set-Location C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice
        .\build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI
        
    - name: Build Website
      run: |
        Set-Location ./Website
        .\build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice
        
    - name: Validate Website
      run: |
        # Run local verification
        Write-Host "Running local website verification..."
        # Add validation steps here
        
    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./Website/dist
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        force_orphan: true
        
    - name: Post-Deployment Cleanup
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        # Clean up temporary files
        Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```
